name: Google STT
description: Dictates through the Google Gemini web microphone instead of the local model. Faster to first word, and the platform handles noise handling and post-processing itself.

settings.label: Show the browser window
settings.description: On: the Chrome window is visible while dictating. Off: it is parked off-screen and runs silently in the background.

settings.label: Response delay
settings.description: How often the transcript is checked after you stop. Lower is faster, higher is gentler on the browser.

settings.label: Stability checks
settings.description: How many consecutive identical reads are required before a transcript is accepted. Higher avoids catching half-written text.

settings.label: Stability interval
settings.description: How long each stability check waits when the text is still changing.

settings.label: Transcript timeout
settings.description: How long to wait for a transcript before reporting that none arrived.

settings.label: Notifications
settings.description: Show a desktop notification when the plugin fails to start or returns an empty transcript.
